resolution.effectiveStateGachaBrowserClock: The effective browser Date.now() and no-argument Date() values followed the page capture clocks despite the declaration.

resolution.visualExporterClock: Use each page's captureClockUnixSeconds in Asia/Shanghai when rebuilding calendar, state, and gacha RenderSpec props.
resolution.acceptance: A merged spec produced with the former 2025 exporter clock is provisional/superseded evidence only and must not drive formal candidate acceptance.
